name: tm-dashboard
description: Live task board for .bytedesk/task-management. HTTP + SSE, tails events.jsonl. The port is assigned once — probed free above 45000, then kept, so the project opens at the same URL every time — and written to .bytedesk/task-management/dashboard.port (TM_DASHBOARD_PORT to pin one). Runs while the plugin is enabled.

name: tm-pool
description: Agent-first pickup loop for .bytedesk/task-management, on by default: each tick collects finished dispatched workers, then dispatches ready-for-agent tasks that pass the readiness check, up to dispatch.poolWip (default 3), preferring touches-disjoint sets. One pool per store: this session runs it, or waits in standby while another session's pool holds pool.pid and takes over when that one exits. Config is re-read every poll, so `tm config dispatch.enabled false` stops it within one poll. Prints state changes only. Explicit control is `tm pool once|start|stop|status|resume`.
